title: chock internals
summary: Inside the engine: the CLI, compile/, the gate builder and gate/runner, hooks/, plugin/, guardrails/, the MCP gateway and the decision log.
intro: chock is one command-line program. Its build-time commands turn each policy into compiled files and wire them into the repo, or package them as plugins. At run time, a small vendored runtime judges each tool call with the gate runner and writes one line to a local log.

boundaries.label: Commands you run, and what they write
Each tool call, on your machine

nodes.label: chock CLI
nodes.card: One entry point. data/commands.json maps each command to the module that runs it. Everyday: init, add, install, remove, sync, check, status, doctor, witness, enable, disable and bundle. Authoring: compile, plugin, marketplace, gateway, mcp, review and compliance, among others.

nodes.label: compile/
nodes.card: Reads one policy folder and runs one emitter per surface: git hook, CI gate, pre-tool-use, stop, Claude managed settings, ambient rule, MCP gateway and agent hooks. chock sync recompiles every policy and rewires the repo.

nodes.label: Gate builder
nodes.card: Turns a manifest's hook.gate into a resolved gate.json. The git-hook, CI and tool-call emitters call it.

nodes.label: .chock/compiled/
nodes.card: What compile writes: one folder per policy, one subfolder per surface, with its gate.json and the hook fragments for each agent. The cited file is chock's own copy for block-invisible-unicode.

nodes.label: plugin/
nodes.card: Packages policies as plugins. chock plugin build makes one package per policy. The selection route (ask the user before running it) merges a whole selection into one plugin per client. A merged plugin carries the client's vendored runtime, as the repo route does.

nodes.label: guardrails/
nodes.card: Turns one policy in a merged plugin on or off. In a merged plugin, every member's hook runs through this wrapper, which reads .chock/guardrails.json, or ~/.chock/guardrails.json outside a repo. A missing or invalid file, or one unlike its reviewed record, means all on. chock bundle on|off is the only writer, and a Stop is refused while a toggle file has loosened.

nodes.label: hooks/
nodes.card: The wiring that sync runs. It merges compiled hook fragments into each agent's own config file, installs the git hooks, and writes each agent's vendored runtime into .chock/bin/.

nodes.label: gateway/ MCP proxy
nodes.card: chock gateway run wraps one MCP server over stdio. Each tools/call is checked against every compiled gateway-gate.json (content_regex, egress_allowlist) before it reaches the server. A block returns a JSON-RPC error. An ask also blocks, because a proxy on a pipe cannot prompt. A gate of an unknown kind refuses the call. A warning goes to stderr and lets the call through.

nodes.label: Agent's client
nodes.card: The coding agent. It runs the registered hook command with the call on stdin, and sends MCP tool calls to a server, which the gateway can wrap. What its hook can enforce is agentseam's data.

nodes.label: Vendored runtime
nodes.card: One stdlib-only file per agent: agentseam's bundle for that agent plus chock's gate handler (gate/runtime_bundle.py). It parses the payload, runs the gate, and answers in the client's own dialect. The cited file is chock's own runtime for Claude Code.

nodes.label: gate/runner
nodes.card: Stdlib only. gate/assemble.py builds it into the single file .chock/bin/gate.py. It evaluates a gate's kind and caps the result by the declared action and the rollout level: observe allows at most a warning, ask at most an ask. It exits 0 allow, 1 block, 2 cannot judge, 3 ask or 4 warn.

nodes.label: Decision log
nodes.card: journal.py holds the log's level, settings, redaction and writer; gate/decision_log.py writes one line per hook call. On the repo route the file is .chock/log/gate-events.jsonl, on the plugin route ~/.chock/log/<agent>/events.jsonl. It never logs contents and never changes the decision.

nodes.label: status and doctor
nodes.card: The log's readers. chock status --only log reads both routes. chock doctor checks that each client's hook is present, current and seen running, and never runs a client. chock witness export writes one client's records, redacted, to a local file and never uploads it.
